coverage.historical_base_note: The original independently audited base extraction supplies this same frozen person before and through April 2003; this supplement appends the subsequent 2003–2009 transcription rows and 2010–2013 original FIDE list rows.
coverage.header_date_policy: Some official ZIP header captions were stale. The exact original download URL and ZIP member both identify the period. Original header text and source_header_period_mismatch are retained; no rating-dependent date reassignment is used.

career_termination.coverage_note: The national federation obituary establishes the end of his playing career on 2013-08-08. Every published official list from January 2010 through December 2013 was checked; the September–December 2013 lists retain his final 2649 rating. This supplement does not claim that every monthly list from 2014 through 2023 was downloaded. The fixed target remains observed published standard ratings through 2023-12, with no post-death games inferred.

identity_audit.historical_source_dob_policy: Some historical transcriptions say1986; retain those source bytes unchanged. Exact FIDE ID and full name anchor the same person; independent original FIDE2010–2013 lists and the national federation obituary confirm1985. No frozen birth feature was changed.
